notes.subject: Yawe
notes.rationale: direct address to Yawe by Name at the verse's center

notes.subject: makumara
notes.rationale: ואתנחם Niphal 'I was comforted' vs KJV reflexive 'I comforted myself' — passive reading preferred

notes.subject: xasala / makuma
notes.rationale: זכר of v49 returns as זכרתי and נחמה of v50 as ואתנחם — the zayin strophe binds remembering and comforting

translation: Ne yɛ i ka sariya-jatebaw xasala, minnu bɔra walɛrɔ kɔrɔ, Yawe, ani ne makumara.
